newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes wither in quiet session, grades steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes wither in quiet session, grades steady.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes staggered through a stagnant session, with the end of May domestic grades winding down at steady and lackluster prices.

Traders said interest in moving May or June barrels lagged on Friday. Most deals were at steady price differentials to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, though there was some support for Louisiana sweets on news Shell was forced to slice Nigerian Forcados production 20 percent.
Continued ethnic fighting saw reduced staffing levels in the region, and led to the move by Shell to trim output. Cash traders said June Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James benefitted.
